notes.title: NEW ROOTS RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
New Roots is a story-driven pixel game about finding hope in our climate crisis. Play as Stick, a young teenage capybara, as they attempt to restore real-life threatened plant species to their native habitats in a post-global warming world similar to our own. 🌰🌱🌼🌻

After a long silence, New Roots is finally available to play on Windows! We've poured our hearts and souls into this game and we truly hope you enjoy it! ✨

Check out New Roots HERE!
